parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this Rlamp entry.

parameters.name: Profile
parameters.description: Profile index used for the RLAPM (Receive Level Added PHY Margin) table.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: Frequency (band) index used for the RLAPM (Receive Level Added PHY Margin) table.

parameters.name: GlobalAggrRxPwrLevel
parameters.description: Global Aggregated Receive Power Level (GARPL). The parameter contains the "Ni" value, where GARPLi = -Ni dBm.

parameters.name: PhyMargin
parameters.description: Receive Level Added Phy Margin (RLAPM). The parameter contains the "Ni" value, where RLAPMi = 0.5*Ni dB.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Reflects the status of a row in this table.

object.description: Interface RLAPM Table supporting the configuration of RLAPM (Receive Level Added PHY Margin) function parameters for the selected profile. The pairs [{{param|GlobalAggrRxPwrLevel}} (GARPLi ), {{param|PhyMargin}} (RLAPMi)] are used to determine the subcarriers' bitloadings according {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 7.15.2 and Table 17-1}}.
